config.label: N: lookahead: show the network the piece after next (queue[1], which the encoding has always thrown away). Read this arm against J, not against G: it is the five feature planes plus one queue plane, so the difference is exactly the queue. If planning for a piece two moves away is what the agent lacks, this is where it shows; the reward, schedule, head, buffer and episodes are G's/J's

training.description: dqn 6000 episodes, seed 4, lr 0.001, batch 64, buffer 50,000, gamma 0.99, eps 1->0.05 over 20,000, target every 500, 256x256, cpu, [per_piece=5]
